comparator.route: Pedagogische Wetenschappen van Primair Onderwijs, ordinary three-year teaching-qualification route
comparator.sourceNotes: The official prospective year pages give 60+60+60=180 EC and explicitly mark the 2026–27 overviews as provisional. Year one lists 52 EC compulsory university courses plus the required 8-EC Bachelorstage 1. Year two lists 48 EC university courses, required 8-EC Bachelorstage 2 and 4 EC genuine academic choice; Analyse 3 is one optional example. Year three lists 31 EC university courses including the 10-EC bachelor thesis, required 7-EC Bachelorstage 3 and 10-EC Afstudeerstage, plus 12 EC genuine academic choice; three named orthopedagogical/professional 4-EC courses are optional instances, not universal requirements. Total required credited primary-school placements are 8+8+7+10=33 EC. The prospectus says graduates receive a bachelor degree with primary-teaching qualification, while the selected ordinary route includes subject didactics, classroom management and final supervised independent teaching. The 0-EC RADAr assessment is excluded. Concurrent prospectus year pages do not guarantee a fixed three-year entrant-cohort schedule.

alternatives.concept: Study how children develop, process language, learn and participate in social environments through developmental and social psychology, cognition, communication and empirical research. One course includes a supervised speaking-and-debate project with primary pupils, but the programme does not provide primary-subject didactics, sustained classroom placements, classroom-management training or teacher qualification.

The 4-EC and 12-EC open choices remain open; optional Analyse 3 and orthopedagogy electives are not imposed as a specialization. All four compulsory placements remain present.

progressionAssessment.rationale: Introduction to Brain & Behavior precedes every dependent cognition and psychology course; research foundations precede advanced statistics, data analysis and research synthesis. The introductory communication and social-science courses precede school-linked and advanced applications. All courses have exact planned offerings, and eight are at 300 level.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Child development, language and educational inquiry is the strongest complete related-fields response. The next candidate—primary teaching, subject didactics and supervised practice—fails because UCR offers only one school-linked communication project and no cumulative literacy, numeracy, classroom-management or placement sequence. Learning difficulties and school quality are supporting topics rather than independent generator-eligible directions, so production stops at one.

notes.text: Radboud PWPO integrates child development and educational research with primary-subject didactics, classroom management, 33 EC of supervised teaching placements and a primary-teaching qualification. UCR can study child development, cognition, language, mental health, school society and research, including one primary-school rhetoric project. It does not provide the professional curriculum or placements required to qualify as a primary teacher.
